quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on the need for Phoenix Suns bigs to improve rebounding
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't matter whether they got the offensive rebounds on me or also on the team.
quotes.quote: I think there is a lot of good stuff and there is a lot of stuff that I need to work on. Obviously we gave up a lot of offensive rebounds. We gave up 11 offensive rebounds, six to Walker and five to Smith. It is something as bigs we got to take pride in that. It doesn't matter whether they got the offensive rebounds on me or also on the team. It still comes back to us because that is our role as bigs to get the rebounds. So that is something we really need to work on and I am just watching film and just learn from each and every game and just continue getting better every game.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach says the Suns bigs need to take more pride in rebounding after giving up 11 offensive boards in their last outing. He says it is a role they have to own as a unit.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach's personal checklist for improving his rim protection and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: It is rebounding, I got to do a better job of that, and just really protecting the rim.
quotes.quote: It is rebounding, I got to do a better job of that, and just really protecting the rim. And when I play hard, everything else will work itself out.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach is focusing on his personal development as a rim protector and rebounder. He says when he plays hard everything else will work itself out.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on the differences between college and NBA rebounding
quotes.excerpt: There is more space in the NBA and the ball can go where you won't be able to get it.
quotes.quote: There is a lot of differences. Pros crash, but college everybody crashes. Pros, some people run back, so it is kind of different. And there is more space in the NBA and the ball can go where you won't be able to get it. The ball can bounce back the other side or you can be in the right position and the ball still goes the wrong way, so I can't control that.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach breaks down the difference between college and NBA rebounding noting that pros run back more and the increased spacing makes tracking the ball more unpredictable.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on the Phoenix Suns' ability to score in waves
quotes.excerpt: We have the first team, a lot of elite scorers and then we have the second team coming in too.
quotes.quote: It is our ability to come in waves. We have the first team, a lot of elite scorers and then we have the second team coming in too and we still have shooters, scorers, everybody scoring and just being able to come at teams in waves and you never know what it is going to look like. It might be a different person this day, the other day it might be a different person that saves the team.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach highlights the Suns depth saying their ability to come at teams in waves with different scorers every night makes them difficult to defend.

quotes.speaker: Khaman Maluach
quotes.summary_phrase: Khaman Maluach on the defensive energy brought by the Suns' second unit
quotes.excerpt: When Goody comes in, Ryan, Collin, Rashir, when they come in, they just bring that energy.
quotes.quote: I feel like it is like that and it is something we all got to work on. But I feel like when Goody comes in, Ryan, Collin, Rashir, when they come in, they just bring that energy. They just bring that juice and really cause chaos in defense.
quotes.social_post: Khaman Maluach praises the defensive energy of the Suns second unit saying players like Goody and Ryan bring the juice and cause chaos on the floor.
